item.title: How I AI — Kath Korevec / OpenAI: ChatGPT Sites, Bring Your Own Connector, Dungeon Skill, "That's My Voice" (Conversational)
item.itunes:title: How I AI — Kath Korevec / OpenAI: ChatGPT Sites, Bring Your Own Connector, Dungeon Skill, "That's My Voice" (Conversational)
item.description:
Atlas Podme Briefing — How I AI with Kath Korevec (OpenAI; works on Codex, leads product for ChatGPT Sites), recorded live at OpenAI DevDay with Claire Vo.
Plugins in Sites (the show notes call it "Plugin Insights"): one URL where each visitor sees their own data through their own connectors, demoed with her incident command site built on live Slack and Notion. The phrase that makes Codex wire in connectors ("bring your own connector"). Sites as infrastructure: database, file storage, hosted MCP plugins. Heavy Rotation, her Reddit-plus-computer-use playlist fix after her kids took over Spotify. A community dungeon crawler that grows through a shared skill. Why faster models mean more creativity, Ultrafast's 8x speed at 6x the cost, and Kath's hard line: the AI never emails or Slacks in her name.
~10:02 conversational Andrew and Ava (tone v2). Skip the Merge and Vanta ads.
Source: https://podcasters.spotify.com/pod/show/pen-name/episodes/How-OpenAI-uses-ChatGPT-Sites-live-at-DevDay---Kath-Korevec-Product-Lead-e3pnm1q
